text:
Jamie: quick ping — PR #2899 blocked by linter (gofumpt) on generated proto tags. CI shows a gofumpt error, can someone with merge/exception perms approve or suggest a tiny tweak? :grimacing:
Sara: can you paste the failure output? I can take a look and push a minimal fix if needed.
Jamie: sure, here's the failing chunk from CI:
```
/workspace/gen/user.pb.go:123:17: `json:\"userId,omitempty\"` should be `json:\"user_id,omitempty\"` (gofumpt)
```
lin-bot: automated check: gofumpt failed for PR #2899 — see details: https://ci.example.com/4567/build/89
Mike: ah the generated proto uses `userId` while the rest of Go code uses snake_case tags. I'd prefer changing the proto to match project convention, but if that touches generated code we might want to avoid churn. small formatting commit is ok too.
Alex: note repo policy requires two approvals for anything touching generated code. Alternatives: (1) add a one-off formatter exemption, (2) change the proto and regen, or (3) adjust the generated file in a tiny followup. I'd avoid exemptions unless unavoidable.
Sara: I can push a tiny followup that normalizes the tag to `json:\"user_id,omitempty\"` and run `gofumpt -w ./...` before pushing. That should keep diffs minimal.
Jamie: thanks — we need to land before the deploy window at 13:00 UTC (about 3 hours). Can folks +1 asynchronously so I can merge when CI is green?
Mike: +1 from me once CI passes.
Alex: I can give the second approval after Sara pushes the fix.
Sara: pushed branch `pr-2899-fmt-fix` — force-pushed the small change and re-ran formatter, kicked CI: `git push origin pr-2899-fmt-fix`
lin-bot: CI update: all checks passed for branch pr-2899-fmt-fix — unit tests, linters, gofumpt. https://ci.example.com/4567/build/90
Mike: looked through diff, nothing surprising. LGTM. :+1:
Alex: lgtm, approving now.
Jamie: awesome — merging in next 10m via merge-bot. :rocket:
Sara: nice — glad we avoided adding a formatter exception. noted in PR description for future reference.
Jamie: merged by merge-bot at 1768511432, closing the thread. Thanks everyone!
